audit.whatIsWrong: Every phases[N].side read 'Skill' while the content layer and the packet both read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Skill/Skill/Hwei/Hwei.
audit.why: Paddle Star! reaches 800 and needs flight time to do real damage, so Hwei's paints answer first at levels 1-3; the lane sits at 49.71% over 1539 games with the swing rows at 4-6.
audit.corrected: Hwei at 1-3 and at both item rows, Skill at 4-5 and 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: winCon, report[1].t and dosFull[2].d all promised a 'fifteen-second' gap on Sleepy Trouble Bubble.
audit.why: Sleepy Trouble Bubble is 18/17/16/15/14s — eighteen seconds at rank 1, never fifteen until rank 4.
audit.corrected: Real cooldown written into every window that references it; Portal Jump's 11/8/5s added as the reason she can re-enter so quickly.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never said what sleep actually does — only that it is 'her kill pattern'.
audit.why: Riot's text: the target becomes drowsy, then falls asleep, their Magic Resist is reduced while asleep, and the first source of damage that breaks the sleep is doubled up to a cap. That doubled hit is the whole combo, and Portal Jump (11s at rank 1, 575 range) is how she gets in range to land the bubble.
audit.corrected: Break the drowsy window by moving out of the bubble's landing spot; if it lands, the next damage on you is doubled, so the answer is spacing before the cast, not after.

audit.whatIsWrong: Twenty-two fields called Zoe 'he', 'his' or 'him' (lint MISGENDER), across tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, phases[0].why, phases[2].why, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, four dosFull/dontsFull titles, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d and six report entries.
audit.why: champ-gender.js marks Zoe female; the template was written for a male enemy and only the name was swapped.
audit.corrected: Every flagged field re-pronouned, at the same length.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were tradeGood/tradeBad under unrelated titles; wants.you and wants.foe each had three entries; wants.foe[2] called Portal Jump a passive.
audit.why: Lint flagged both bleeds; Portal Jump is Zoe's R at 11/8/5s, not a passive — her passive is More Sparkles!, an attack-damage proc after a spell.
audit.corrected: Bodies rewritten to their titles, Portal Jump named as the R, and a fourth want added on each side.

notes: Twenty-two misgendered fields fixed — Zoe was called he/his/him throughout, including six report entries. Those report edits are pronoun-only and were made because lint flagged them by name, not as sweep expansion. Cooldown error corrected in three places: winCon, report[1].t and dosFull[2].d all called Sleepy Trouble Bubble a fifteen-second cooldown; it is 18s at rank 1. wants.foe[2] called Portal Jump a passive; it is her R at 11/8/5s. The derived flags on Zoe's E include trueDamage and terrain, both of which contradict Riot's description (drowsy into sleep, reduced Magic Resist, doubled waking damage, no terrain and no true damage), so I wrote nothing about either — flag misfire, recorded as unverified. Structural gap filled: both wants arrays had 3 entries, so a fourth was added on each with before:null.
